claims.quote: Globoid cell leukodystrophy (GLD) is a progressive neurodegenerative disease caused by galactocerebrosidase deficiency.
HSCT significantly impacts the natural history of juvenile GLD, resulting in largely optimal long-term outcomes, preserved quality of life, and minimal disability.
Two symptomatic patients-with extensive pre-HSCT white matter disease and specific pre-HSCT clinical features (epilepsy and cognitive impairment)-had suboptimal outcomes.
